// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/blueprints: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const BLUEPRINT_LIMITS: {
    readonly parts: 128;
    readonly steps: 128;
};

export interface Blueprint {
    title: TextRef;
    parts: BlueprintPart[];
    purpose: {
        audience: TextRef;
        work: TextRef;
        inputs: TextRef;
        outputs: TextRef;
        first_result: TextRef;
    };
    steps: Array<{
        step_id: string;
        title: TextRef;
        part_ids: string[];
    }>;
    example_task: {
        title: TextRef;
        input: TextRef;
        step_ids: string[];
        result: {
            part_id: string;
            location: TextRef;
        };
    };
}

export interface BlueprintPart {
    part_id: string;
    required: boolean;
    layer: SettingLayer;
    proposal: BlueprintProposal;
}

export type BlueprintProposal = {
    kind: "capability";
    requires: PluginRequirementDeclaration;
} | {
    kind: "skill";
    skill: {
        pack: string;
        skill_id: string;
    };
    state: "auto" | "manual";
} | {
    kind: "role";
    template: RoleTemplate;
} | {
    kind: "setting";
    key: string;
    value: SandboxJson;
} | {
    kind: "connection";
    category: string;
    purpose: TextRef;
} | {
    kind: "content";
    type: string;
    body: SandboxJson;
};
